property_summary: After any sequence of addToBalance and withdrawBalance calls, no single user can end up with a balance of exactly 1 if they have never interacted with the contract; the buggy version allows a user who withdraws to retain a balance of 1.
change_summary: Replace `userBalance[msg.sender] = 0` with `userBalance[msg.sender] = 1`, so the balance becomes 1 instead of 0 after withdraw.
